_readme: The ONLY guides the Send guide tile can email. No folder is ever scanned. Each PDF lives in send_guide.guides_dir (default C:\CEC\runtime\hub-guides, outside every repo and sync folder) at 'path', and is refused at send time unless its SHA-256 still matches. To add or replace a guide: copy the approved final export from second-brain handouts\exports\ into guides_dir, put its sha256 here with the approval reference, set active true, commit. To withdraw one: active false. Care and decision guides only: the referral flyer and the collecting print pack (guide + flyer) are PRINT-ONLY and never go in this list (Codex 1 Nov 2026, commercial-message rules).
